subject: Vendr evidence hardening & minimal manifest — onboarding ask
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmepay.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmepay.com
Date: 2027-04-06T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr onboarding — SOC2/CAIQ snapshot for vendor profile

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're starting the vendor portal onboarding for Redwood on Vendr and want to get you a compact package to speed the profile verification. Our security team can export the following today:

- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (latest period) — we'll redact customer data as needed. (attached stub)
- CAIQ JSON export for our environment
- Completed SIG-lite answers for infra and data protection sections
- A short owner list for privileged service accounts and service principal fingerprints

Question for you: Is Vendr presigned S3 upload acceptable, or do you require us to upload directly into the Vendr UI? We can provision a short-lived S3 presign URL or add the evidence via the portal using a service account.

Also, Redwood mentioned a "minimal evidence manifest" to annotate proof-of-possession and TTLs for assets — do you have a template we should populate? We want to avoid repeated follow-ups and make it easy for your reviewers to QC.

Attached: ACME_SOC2_Redacted.pdf (redacted stub)

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Senior Security Program Manager
AcmePay

--
ACME Security (security@acmepay.com)

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmepay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-06T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — SOC2/CAIQ snapshot for vendor profile

Alice — thanks and much appreciated. Short answers up front: presigned S3 upload is fine (we'll provide a one-time presign), and we can also accept direct upload to Vendr if you prefer.

To reduce back-and-forth, we've defined a small "evidence hardening manifest" that we use for initial onboarding reviews. It captures the minimal attributes our SOC/infosec reviewers need to accept an artifact and mark it as "proof-of-possession" in our tracker. I attached our template (CSV) — fields we ask vendors to fill are:

- artifact_name
- artifact_type (SOC2 / CAIQ / SIG / KMS-proof / PKCS-export)
- period_end_date
- owner_name
- owner_email
- proof_possession_signature (name + date)
- storage_location (Vendr link or S3 presign)
- ttl_days (how long the evidence remains accessible)
- redaction_notes

If you can populate that and either upload to Vendr or drop the files at the presign we provide, our security ops team will QC within 48 business hours.

A couple of clarifying asks: if the SOC2 has a supporting control narrative PDF, please include it (even if redacted). For service accounts, list the principal id and any key fingerprint (sha256) so we can correlate to your service-account claims in the SIG answers.

Ben and Naomi — looping you in to own the presign and QC respectively. Ben, can you create the presigned S3 bucket and share the window? Naomi, if you can triage any artifacts that look incomplete, we'll request a follow-up from Acme.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-manifest-template.csv

From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmepay.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmepay.com
Date: 2027-04-06T13:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — SOC2/CAIQ snapshot for vendor profile

Rafael — thanks, that template is great and very clear. We'll do the following:

1) Fill the manifest and attach the CAIQ export + SIG-lite answers.
2) Provide the redacted SOC2 PDF and a short control narrative for the encryption and key management controls.
3) For uploads, we'll take the presigned S3 route to avoid creating a new portal user. We'll populate the manifest with TTLs — can you confirm a recommended TTL?

Proposed timeline: we can have the manifest + artifacts uploaded by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-07) if the presign is provisioned today.

DocuSign / access note: we are happy to provision a Vendr service account if you prefer the portal entry, but presign is faster for this sprint.

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-08T11:44:00-07:00
Subject: Internal — presign prepared for AcmePay (ACME_UPLOAD_20270407)

Raf / Naomi — I created a one-time presigned bucket for AcmePay: s3://redwood-evidence-temp/ACME_UPLOAD_20270407/ (presign window: 48 hours from token issuance). I emailed the presign URL to Alice this morning with instructions to populate your manifest and upload artifacts under a top-level folder named by artifact_type.

Quick plan:
- Ben: presign created and logged in Vault (safeguard).
- Naomi: you will QC the manifest after the upload and tag artifacts in Vendr with our internal mapping (artifact_name -> proof_id). Look for: SOC2 period_end_date, control narrative present, and at least one key-fingerprint for each privileged principal listed.
- Rafael: we may need a quick acceptance note for any artifacts we mark as "provisional" while we request deeper evidence (e.g., KMS attestation).

Naomi — I'll forward the presign link to Acme now; when you see uploads start, can you prioritize ACME_SOC2_Redacted.pdf and the CAIQ export? If anything looks off, we'll ask for an updated manifest entry (use the proof_possession_signature field).

Ben
Senior Security Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
